author: Varun Mayya
description:
I just tried creating this cool story idea I had using a new tool called Sherpa by Pocket FM. It’s basically like your “AI fiction writing partner” that helps you write, create, and publish stories. But the cool thing about Sherpa is that it’s built specifically for fiction, which in my own testing, is kinda true. Anyway, it’s completely free to try. You might wanna give it a try.

#ad
title: I Turned My Story Idea Into Reality With AI
